title: Anti‑thromboinflammation of triherbal extract in diabetic rats
core_idea: To evaluate the effects of a blended aqueous extract (1:1:1) of Moringa oleifera, Ocimum gratissimum, and Vernonia amygdalina on markers of thromboinflammation in experimentally induced diabetic rats; treatments (150 mg/kg of individual and blended extracts) were given for 28 days, acute toxicity assessed by the Lorke technique, and platelet and white blood cell parameters measured by automated hematology analyzer.
tldr: Study tests whether a 1:1:1 blended aqueous extract of moringa, ocimum, and vernonia (150 mg/kg for 28 days) affects thromboinflammation-related blood markers in diabetic rats, with acute toxicity evaluation.
